visual.detailed_description: Frontal-looking chest radiograph in grayscale with a white letter "R" printed at the upper left. A thin blue arrow in the upper left part of the picture points toward the upper edge of a large rounded opacity in the lower chest. Below the arrow, the lower chest and upper abdomen are filled by a large mottled, bubbly gray-white region with rounded dark pockets of air at the lower left of the picture and a large dilated rounded shape in the lower middle; the heart shadow and mediastinum are partly merged with it. ECG-style electrode patches and long looped lead wires cross the chest and run off the right and bottom edges; two clips and snap connectors are visible on the chest. A thin dark red line runs along the bottom and left edges of the picture. No printed date, name, identifier or device text is visible apart from the letter "R".
